contracts.activation_semantics: active where the lagged difference is finite and nonzero
expected_invariants: constant input is zero after warm-up
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN unless both endpoints are finite

contracts.activation_semantics: active where a complete window has nonzero fitted slope
contracts.canonical_semantics: ordinary-least-squares slope over the trailing window including t
expected_invariants: linear input recovers its per-coordinate slope
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN unless the complete trailing window is finite
contracts.window_semantics: window is the full OLS sample length

contracts.activation_semantics: active where the lag-window second difference is finite and nonzero
expected_invariants: linear input is zero after warm-up
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN unless all three lag endpoints are finite
contracts.window_semantics: window is the lag used by both first differences

contracts.activation_semantics: continuous occupancy fraction; not an event counter
contracts.canonical_semantics: fraction of values strictly above threshold in the complete trailing window
contracts.event_state_assumptions: state is raw x > threshold, never an implicit rolling z-score
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN unless the complete trailing window is finite
contracts.window_semantics: window is the occupancy sample length

contracts.activation_semantics: increments only while x > threshold and resets to zero otherwise
contracts.canonical_semantics: length of the current consecutive active run, including t; zero while inactive
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN resets the run; output is NaN at the missing coordinate
contracts.window_semantics: window is not used; threshold defines active state

contracts.activation_semantics: tracks both active and inactive state age
contracts.canonical_semantics: age of the current boolean state since its most recent transition; zero on transition
contracts.event_state_assumptions: raw threshold state; distinct from active-only Duration
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN resets state identity; output is NaN at the missing coordinate
contracts.window_semantics: window is not used; threshold defines boolean state

contracts.activation_semantics: increments after a rising activation until the next activation
contracts.canonical_semantics: elapsed coordinates since the latest rising threshold activation; zero at a hit
contracts.event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
contracts.output_domain: nonnegative float panel with NaN before first hit
contracts.warm_up_rule: NaN until the first rising activation in each finite segment

contracts.activation_semantics: holds the last activation coordinate until the next activation
contracts.canonical_semantics: absolute time-coordinate index of the latest rising threshold activation
contracts.event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: equals coordinate index at a hit
contracts.output_domain: float coordinate-index panel with NaN before first hit
contracts.warm_up_rule: NaN until the first rising activation in each finite segment

contracts.activation_semantics: one at only the first activation, zero at later activations in the segment
contracts.canonical_semantics: one-shot pulse at the first rising threshold activation of each finite segment
contracts.event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: at most one pulse per finite segment
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN resets the segment; output is NaN at the missing coordinate

contracts.activation_semantics: reports every state transition, not only the first
contracts.canonical_semantics: signed boolean-state change: +1 rising, -1 falling, 0 unchanged
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN resets state; first finite active state is a +1 activation

contracts.activation_semantics: active where early and late path thirds differ
contracts.canonical_semantics: mean(last third) - mean(first third) inside the complete trailing window
contracts.event_state_assumptions: path geometry; not a short-minus-long moving average
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN unless the complete trailing window is finite
contracts.window_semantics: window is split into non-overlapping first/last thirds and must be >=3

contracts.activation_semantics: counts rising activations, not active-state occupancy or arbitrary value changes
contracts.canonical_semantics: count of rising threshold activations in the trailing window
contracts.event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: persistent active state does not create repeated events
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN resets event history; windows never cross a missing coordinate
contracts.warm_up_rule: window-1 coordinates inside each finite segment
contracts.window_semantics: window is the event-count lookback including t

contracts.activation_semantics: active where short and long path levels differ
contracts.canonical_semantics: trailing short-window mean minus trailing long-window mean
expected_invariants: short window must be strictly smaller than long window
contracts.missing_value_rule: NaN unless both complete windows are finite
